They are applying for Biomedical Engineering and have taken 12 AP courses, including AP Human Geography, AP Chemistry, AP Comparative Government, AP Computer Science A, AP Physics C Electricity and Magnetism, AP Macroeconomics, AP Seminar, AP Art History, AP Physics 1, AP French Language, and AP English Literature. The applicant is expected to graduate in 2026.
